queries.target_definition: Complete the required aerial movement under the conditions associated with the context, without external assistance.
Complete the required distance by continuous running at at least the specified pace on the stated terrain, in the stipulated current state, without assistance or walking breaks.
The stipulated individual remains alive for the full interval under the supplied environmental and resource conditions, without rescue. Temporary stress or reversible damage is allowed.
Be alive at the end of the specified interval under the stated conditions. Temporary wilting or damage is allowed; growth, flowering, and perfect health are not required.
Satisfy all elements of the supplied hypothetical property-damage offence without an applicable situation-specific exception. This is not a determination under real-world law.
